name: Thomas Kurmann, PhD
title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer | Robotic Perception & Real-Time ML
bio: Staff Machine Learning Engineer (PhD) building production-grade real-time computer vision for robotic surgery. Specialized in stereo depth estimation, multi-task perception, multi-spectral imaging, and efficient edge AI under strict latency and robustness constraints.

Led the end-to-end delivery of production 3D perception for the da Vinci platform, from synthetic data generation and model development through optimized on-device deployment, supporting FDA 510(k) clearance activities. Expertise in stereo vision, multi-view geometry, and embedded ML with applications spanning robotics, AR/3D, and autonomy.

Author of 6 peer-reviewed publications (5 first-author), including MICCAI, Nature Scientific Reports, and IJCARS. Recipient of the MICCAI Young Scientist Award and EndoVis Challenge 1st (2015) and 2nd (2017).
